note: Mock (paper) portfolio for a calibration experiment - no real money. Entry prices and watch-list refs are RE-BASELINED to yfinance closes on 2026-07-11; the original web-search-sourced prices were inconsistent for several names, so yfinance became the single source of truth and day zero = 0%. Tickers get an .AX suffix for yfinance (ASX). Shares are computed from alloc/entry at run time. Money P&L is a SECONDARY metric here - the primary output is calibration; see predictions.json and score.py.

integrity.note: Plausibility-gate thresholds for prices.py. stale_sessions: identical closes across this many sessions => 'stale'. outlier_pct: absolute 1-day move above this => 'outlier' (a FLAG, not a rejection; high-vol names can legitimately exceed it). divergence_pct: yfinance vs EODHD difference above this => 'divergence'.
